def hera_task_from_cferp(assignment: Assignment, workflow: Any | None = None) -> Any:
    """Build a HERA task for a single Lead-issued Assessor assignment."""
    if assignment.role != Role.ASSESSOR:
        raise IntegrationError("HERA task requires an Assessor Lead assignment")
    from hera1 import AssessmentTask, EvidenceMaterial
    kind = assignment.context.get("task_kind", "evidence_review")
    base = dict(schema_version="1", task_id=assignment.assignment_id,
        work_item_id=assignment.context.get("source_work_item_id", assignment.assignment_id),
        event_id=f"hera-event:{assignment.assignment_id}",
        case_id=assignment.manifest.case_id, case_snapshot_id=assignment.manifest.case_snapshot_id,
        board_version=str(assignment.manifest.board_version), task_kind=kind,
        sender_role="evidence_worker" if kind in {"evidence_review", "request_review"} else "lead",
        sender_id=assignment.owner_id)
    if kind == "evidence_review":
        link = assignment.context.get("candidate_link")
        claim = assignment.context.get("claim")
        material = assignment.context.get("material")
        if not isinstance(link, dict) or claim is None or material is None:
            raise IntegrationError("evidence review assignment lacks its claim, passage, or material")
        evidence = EvidenceMaterial(str(link["passage_id"]), str(link["material_id"]),
            str(link["material_version"]), str(link.get("representation_id") or
            f"{link['material_id']}:{link['material_version']}:text"), str(link["exact_text"]),
            str(link.get("source_kind", material.source_kind)),
            link.get("start_offset") if type(link.get("start_offset")) is int else 0,
            {"title": material.title, "need_ids": list(link.get("need_ids", ())),
             "slot_id": link.get("slot_id"),
             **({"passage_context": dict(link["passage_context"])} if link.get("passage_context") else {})})
        cferp_claim_kind = str(getattr(claim, "kind", "other"))
        hera_claim_type = {
            "incident_event": "incident_fact",
            "incident_causal_link": "incident_causal_link",
            "causal_link": "incident_causal_link",
            "system_mechanism": "general_mechanism",
            "general_mechanism": "general_mechanism",
        }.get(cferp_claim_kind, "other")
        hypothesis = {"hypothesis_id": str(link["claim_id"]), "parts": [{
            "part_id": f"claim:{claim.claim_id}", "board_ids": [claim.claim_id],
            "claim_type": hera_claim_type,
            "text": claim.text}]}
        return AssessmentTask(**base, materials=(evidence,), hypothesis=hypothesis,
            context={"task_kind": kind, "claim_id": claim.claim_id,
                     "candidate_link": dict(link), "packet_id": assignment.context.get("packet_id")})
    if kind == "reassessment_triage":
        material = assignment.context.get("material")
        prior = tuple(assignment.context.get("prior_assessments", ()))
        if material is None or not prior:
            raise IntegrationError("reassessment assignment lacks revised material or prior assessments")
        evidence = EvidenceMaterial(material.material_id, material.material_id, material.version,
            f"{material.material_id}:{material.version}:text", material.content or "",
            material.source_kind, 0, {"title": material.title, "reassessment": True})
        claim_id = assignment.target_ids[0]
        claim_text = (workflow.claims[claim_id].text if workflow is not None and claim_id in workflow.claims
                      else str(assignment.context.get("claim_text", claim_id)))
        from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
        return AssessmentTask(**base, materials=(evidence,), hypothesis={"hypothesis_id": claim_id,
            "parts": [{"part_id": f"claim:{claim_id}", "board_ids": [claim_id],
                       "claim_type": "incident_fact", "text": claim_text}]},
            prior_assessment_ids=tuple(assignment.context["prior_assessment_ids"]),
            context={"prior_assessment_ids": list(assignment.context["prior_assessment_ids"]),
                     "prior_assessments": [dict(item) if isinstance(item, dict) else asdict(item)
                                            for item in prior if isinstance(item, dict) or is_dataclass(item)]})
    if kind == "request_review":
        request = assignment.context.get("request")
        if request is None:
            raise IntegrationError("request review assignment has no Lead request")
        request_kind = "document_request" if request.request_kind == "document_request" else "question"
        found = [row for row in assignment.context.get("existing_candidate_links", ()) if isinstance(row, dict)]
        shown = [{"candidate_link_id": row.get("candidate_link_id"), "source_id": row.get("source_id"),
                  "slot_id": row.get("slot_id"),
                  "exact_text": str(row.get("exact_text", ""))[:MAX_REVIEW_LINK_CHARS]}
                 for row in found[:MAX_REVIEW_LINKS]]
        link_context = {"existing_candidate_links": shown}
        if len(found) > len(shown):
            link_context["omitted_candidate_link_count"] = len(found) - len(shown)
        return AssessmentTask(**base, request={"request_id": request.request_id,
            "target_id": request.target_ids[0] if request.target_ids else "",
            "kind": request_kind, "request_type": request_kind,
            "text": request.wording, "slot_ids": list(request.slot_ids),
            "requested_fields": list(request.record_types), "why_it_may_help": ""},
            context={"task_kind": kind, "request_id": request.request_id,
                     "origin_ids": list(request.origin_ids), "request_version": request.request_version,
                     **link_context})
    if kind == "clarification_review":
        answer = assignment.context.get("clarification")
        if answer is None:
            raise IntegrationError("clarification review assignment has no routed answer")
        need = assignment.context.get("need")
        if need is None and workflow is not None:
            need = workflow.lead.needs.get(answer.need_id)
        question = ""
        if need is not None:
            question = " ".join(slot.description for slot in need.slots)
        answer_kind = "document" if answer.source_material_ids else "human"
        materials = []
        unassessable = []
        for material_id in answer.source_material_ids:
            material = workflow.materials.get(material_id) if workflow is not None else None
            if material is None or not material.content:
                unassessable.append({"source_id": material_id,
                                     "reason": "no searchable text supplied to HERA"})
                continue
            materials.append(EvidenceMaterial(material.material_id, material.material_id,
                material.version, f"{material.material_id}:{material.version}:text",
                material.content, material.source_kind, 0, {"title": material.title}))
        answer_data = {"question_id": answer.clarification_id, "answer_id": answer.answer_id,
            "kind": answer_kind, "text": answer.answer_text}
        return AssessmentTask(**base, clarification={"question_id": answer.clarification_id,
            "text": question, "why_it_matters": "Clarification routed by the Lead."},
            answer=answer_data, materials=tuple(materials),
            context={"task_kind": kind, "need_id": answer.need_id,
                     "unassessable_materials": unassessable})
    raise IntegrationError(f"automated HERA builder does not yet support task kind {kind}")


def sahs_result_to_cferp(result: Any, assignment: Assignment,
                         *, result_id: str | None = None) -> RoleResult:
    """Normalize an SAHS delta for the Lead's CFERP commit gate.

    Source IDs must already be CFERP material IDs; ``sahs_sources_from_materials``
    creates that contract at assignment construction time. Candidate operations
    are intentionally not auto-applied: branch activation and merge decisions
    remain Lead actions.
    """
    if _get(result, "assignment_id") != assignment.assignment_id:
        raise IntegrationError("SAHS result does not match its Lead assignment ID")
    if (_get(result, "case_snapshot_id") != assignment.manifest.case_snapshot_id
            or str(_get(result, "board_version")) != str(assignment.manifest.board_version)):
        raise IntegrationError("SAHS result does not match its Lead assignment snapshot")
    status = _get(result, "status")
    if status not in {"completed", "open_frontier", "partial_budget", "no_candidate_under_supplied_rules", "no_op"}:
        raise IntegrationError(f"SAHS result is not commit-ready: {status}")

    graph = _get(result, "graph_delta")
    props = _get(graph, "propositions", ()) or ()
    rules = _get(graph, "rules", ()) or ()
    candidates = _get(result, "candidates", ()) or ()
    memberships: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for candidate in candidates:
        candidate_id = _get(candidate, "candidate_id")
        if not candidate_id:
            continue
        for proposition_id in (_get(candidate, "proposition_ids", ()) or ()):
            memberships.setdefault(proposition_id, []).append(str(candidate_id))
    shared_ids = sorted(candidate_id for candidate_id in memberships.values() if len(candidate_id) > 1)
    shared_branch = ("sahs:shared:" + sha256(json.dumps(shared_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
                     if shared_ids else None)
    available_sources = {(source_id, version)
                         for source_id, version, *_ in assignment.manifest.source_versions}
    for rule in rules:
        for ref in (_get(rule, "source_refs", ()) or ()):
            source_pair = (_get(ref, "source_id"), _get(ref, "source_version"))
            if available_sources and source_pair not in available_sources:
                raise IntegrationError(f"SAHS cites source/version outside its Lead assignment: {source_pair}")
            if not available_sources:
                catalog = assignment.context.get("source_catalog", ())
                if not any((_get(item, "material_id"), _get(item, "version")) == source_pair
                           for item in catalog):
                    raise IntegrationError(f"SAHS cites source/version not present in Lead assignment: {source_pair}")
    claims = [{
        "claim_id": _get(prop, "proposition_id"),
        "text": _get(prop, "text"),
        "kind": _get(prop, "kind", "hypothesis"),
        "branch_id": _branch_for_proposition(result, prop, memberships, shared_branch),
        "parent_claim_ids": tuple(_get(prop, "parent_claim_ids", ()) or assignment.target_ids),
        "dependency_ids": tuple(_get(prop, "dependency_ids", ()) or ()),
        "provenance": tuple(_get(ref, "source_id") for ref in (_get(prop, "source_refs", ()) or ())),
    } for prop in props]
    links = []
    link_ids_by_rule: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for rule in rules:
        refs = tuple(_get(rule, "source_refs", ()) or ())
        basis = _get(rule, "basis", "model_proposed")
        if basis == "source_described" and not refs:
            raise IntegrationError("source-described SAHS rule has no source passage")
        # CFERP currently stores one source passage per causal link. Split a
        # multi-source SAHS rule into provenance-specific links instead of
        # pairing one quote with a list of unrelated source IDs.
        provenance_rows = refs if basis == "source_described" else (None,)
        for idx, ref in enumerate(provenance_rows):
            refs_for_row = (ref,) if ref is not None else refs
            link_id = _get(rule, "rule_id")
            if len(provenance_rows) > 1:
                link_id = f"{link_id}:source:{idx}"
            link_ids_by_rule.setdefault(str(_get(rule, "rule_id")), []).append(link_id)
            links.append({
                "link_id": link_id,
                "source_claim_ids": tuple(_get(rule, "antecedent_ids", ()) or ()),
                "target_claim_id": _get(rule, "consequent_id"),
                "relation": _get(rule, "relation", "may_cause"),
                "modality": _get(rule, "modality", "may"),
                "basis": basis,
                "source_refs": tuple(_get(row_ref, "source_id") for row_ref in refs_for_row),
                "source_relation": _get(rule, "source_relation") or "inference",
                "source_text": _get(ref, "exact_text", "") if ref is not None else "",
                "conditions": tuple(_get(rule, "conditions", ()) or ()),
                "time_constraint": _get(rule, "time_constraint") or "unknown",
            })
    needs = []

def hera_task_from_cferp(assignment: Assignment, workflow: Any | None = None) -> Any:
    """Build a HERA task for a single Lead-issued Assessor assignment."""
    if assignment.role != Role.ASSESSOR:
        raise IntegrationError("HERA task requires an Assessor Lead assignment")
    from hera1 import AssessmentTask, EvidenceMaterial
    kind = assignment.context.get("task_kind", "evidence_review")
    base = dict(schema_version="1", task_id=assignment.assignment_id,
        work_item_id=assignment.context.get("source_work_item_id", assignment.assignment_id),
        event_id=f"hera-event:{assignment.assignment_id}",
        case_id=assignment.manifest.case_id, case_snapshot_id=assignment.manifest.case_snapshot_id,
        board_version=str(assignment.manifest.board_version), task_kind=kind,
        sender_role="evidence_worker" if kind in {"evidence_review", "request_review"} else "lead",
        sender_id=assignment.owner_id)
    if kind == "evidence_review":
        link = assignment.context.get("candidate_link")
        claim = assignment.context.get("claim")
        material = assignment.context.get("material")
        if not isinstance(link, dict) or claim is None or material is None:
            raise IntegrationError("evidence review assignment lacks its claim, passage, or material")
        evidence = EvidenceMaterial(str(link["passage_id"]), str(link["material_id"]),
            str(link["material_version"]), str(link.get("representation_id") or
            f"{link['material_id']}:{link['material_version']}:text"), str(link["exact_text"]),
            str(link.get("source_kind", material.source_kind)),
            link.get("start_offset") if type(link.get("start_offset")) is int else 0,
            {"title": material.title, "need_ids": list(link.get("need_ids", ())),
             "slot_id": link.get("slot_id"),
             **({"passage_context": dict(link["passage_context"])} if link.get("passage_context") else {})})
        cferp_claim_kind = str(getattr(claim, "kind", "other"))
        hera_claim_type = {
            "incident_event": "incident_fact",
            "incident_causal_link": "incident_causal_link",
            "causal_link": "incident_causal_link",
            "system_mechanism": "general_mechanism",
            "general_mechanism": "general_mechanism",
        }.get(cferp_claim_kind, "other")
        hypothesis = {"hypothesis_id": str(link["claim_id"]), "parts": [{
            "part_id": f"claim:{claim.claim_id}", "board_ids": [claim.claim_id],
            "claim_type": hera_claim_type,
            "text": claim.text}]}
        return AssessmentTask(**base, materials=(evidence,), hypothesis=hypothesis,
            context={"task_kind": kind, "claim_id": claim.claim_id,
                     "candidate_link": dict(link), "packet_id": assignment.context.get("packet_id")})
    if kind == "reassessment_triage":
        material = assignment.context.get("material")
        prior = tuple(assignment.context.get("prior_assessments", ()))
        if material is None or not prior:
            raise IntegrationError("reassessment assignment lacks revised material or prior assessments")
        evidence = EvidenceMaterial(material.material_id, material.material_id, material.version,
            f"{material.material_id}:{material.version}:text", material.content or "",
            material.source_kind, 0, {"title": material.title, "reassessment": True})
        claim_id = assignment.target_ids[0]
        claim_text = (workflow.claims[claim_id].text if workflow is not None and claim_id in workflow.claims
                      else str(assignment.context.get("claim_text", claim_id)))
        from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
        return AssessmentTask(**base, materials=(evidence,), hypothesis={"hypothesis_id": claim_id,
            "parts": [{"part_id": f"claim:{claim_id}", "board_ids": [claim_id],
                       "claim_type": "incident_fact", "text": claim_text}]},
            prior_assessment_ids=tuple(assignment.context["prior_assessment_ids"]),
            context={"prior_assessment_ids": list(assignment.context["prior_assessment_ids"]),
                     "prior_assessments": [dict(item) if isinstance(item, dict) else asdict(item)
                                            for item in prior if isinstance(item, dict) or is_dataclass(item)]})
    if kind == "request_review":
        request = assignment.context.get("request")
        if request is None:
            raise IntegrationError("request review assignment has no Lead request")
        request_kind = "document_request" if request.request_kind == "document_request" else "question"
        found = [row for row in assignment.context.get("existing_candidate_links", ()) if isinstance(row, dict)]
        shown = [{"candidate_link_id": row.get("candidate_link_id"), "source_id": row.get("source_id"),
                  "slot_id": row.get("slot_id"),
                  "exact_text": str(row.get("exact_text", ""))[:MAX_REVIEW_LINK_CHARS]}
                 for row in found[:MAX_REVIEW_LINKS]]
        link_context = {"existing_candidate_links": shown}
        if len(found) > len(shown):
            link_context["omitted_candidate_link_count"] = len(found) - len(shown)
        return AssessmentTask(**base, request={"request_id": request.request_id,
            "target_id": request.target_ids[0] if request.target_ids else "",
            "kind": request_kind, "request_type": request_kind,
            "text": request.wording, "slot_ids": list(request.slot_ids),
            "requested_fields": list(request.record_types), "why_it_may_help": ""},
            context={"task_kind": kind, "request_id": request.request_id,
                     "origin_ids": list(request.origin_ids), "request_version": request.request_version,
                     **link_context})
    if kind == "clarification_review":
        answer = assignment.context.get("clarification")
        if answer is None:
            raise IntegrationError("clarification review assignment has no routed answer")
        need = assignment.context.get("need")
        if need is None and workflow is not None:
            need = workflow.lead.needs.get(answer.need_id)
        question = ""
        if need is not None:
            question = " ".join(slot.description for slot in need.slots)
        answer_kind = "document" if answer.source_material_ids else "human"
        materials = []
        unassessable = []
        for material_id in answer.source_material_ids:
            material = workflow.materials.get(material_id) if workflow is not None else None
            if material is None or not material.content:
                unassessable.append({"source_id": material_id,
                                     "reason": "no searchable text supplied to HERA"})
                continue
            materials.append(EvidenceMaterial(material.material_id, material.material_id,
                material.version, f"{material.material_id}:{material.version}:text",
                material.content, material.source_kind, 0, {"title": material.title}))
        answer_data = {"question_id": answer.clarification_id, "answer_id": answer.answer_id,
            "kind": answer_kind, "text": answer.answer_text}
        return AssessmentTask(**base, clarification={"question_id": answer.clarification_id,
            "text": question, "why_it_matters": "Clarification routed by the Lead."},
            answer=answer_data, materials=tuple(materials),
            context={"task_kind": kind, "need_id": answer.need_id,
                     "unassessable_materials": unassessable})
    raise IntegrationError(f"automated HERA builder does not yet support task kind {kind}")


def sahs_result_to_cferp(result: Any, assignment: Assignment,

    """Normalize an SAHS delta for the Lead's CFERP commit gate.

        raise IntegrationError("SAHS result does not match its Lead assignment ID")

            or str(_get(result, "board_version")) != str(assignment.manifest.board_version)):
        raise IntegrationError("SAHS result does not match its Lead assignment snapshot")
    status = _get(result, "status")

    memberships: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for candidate in candidates:
        candidate_id = _get(candidate, "candidate_id")
        if not candidate_id:
            continue
        for proposition_id in (_get(candidate, "proposition_ids", ()) or ()):
            memberships.setdefault(proposition_id, []).append(str(candidate_id))
    shared_ids = sorted(candidate_id for candidate_id in memberships.values() if len(candidate_id) > 1)
    shared_branch = ("sahs:shared:" + sha256(json.dumps(shared_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
                     if shared_ids else None)

                         for source_id, version, *_ in assignment.manifest.source_versions}
    for rule in rules:
        for ref in (_get(rule, "source_refs", ()) or ()):

                link_id = f"{link_id}:source:{idx}"

            links.append({
                "link_id": link_id,
                "source_claim_ids": tuple(_get(rule, "antecedent_ids", ()) or ()),
                "target_claim_id": _get(rule, "consequent_id"),
                "relation": _get(rule, "relation", "may_cause"),
                "modality": _get(rule, "modality", "may"),
                "basis": basis,
                "source_refs": tuple(_get(row_ref, "source_id") for row_ref in refs_for_row),
                "source_relation": _get(rule, "source_relation") or "inference",
                "source_text": _get(ref, "exact_text", "") if ref is not None else "",
                "conditions": tuple(_get(rule, "conditions", ()) or ()),
                "time_constraint": _get(rule, "time_constraint") or "unknown",

    needs = []

        question = _get(gap, "unknown", "")
        needs.append({"need_id": need_id, "target_ids": _linked_targets(gap, assignment.target_ids),

                      "origin_kind": "specialist_gap"})
    clarifications = []
    for item in (_get(result, "clarification_items", ()) or ()):
        clarification_id = _get(item, "clarification_id")
        question = _get(item, "question", "")
        clarifications.append({"need_id": clarification_id, "target_ids": _linked_targets(item, assignment.target_ids),
                               "slots": [{"slot_id": f"{clarification_id}:slot", "description": question,
                                          "record_type": "term_or_configuration_clarification"}],
                               "origin_kind": "specialist_clarification"})
    payload = {"specialist_status": status, "claims": claims, "causal_links": links, "needs": needs,
               "clarifications": clarifications,
               "candidate_memberships": [{"candidate_id": _get(candidate, "candidate_id"),
                   "proposition_ids": tuple(_get(candidate, "proposition_ids", ()) or ()),

                                     for link_id in link_ids_by_rule.get(str(rule_id), (rule_id,)))}
                   for candidate in candidates]}
    return RoleResult(result_id or f"sahs:{assignment.assignment_id}", assignment.assignment_id,
                      Role.SPECIALIST, assignment.manifest, payload)

COMPARE_STATEMENTS = """Compare the extracted source statements with every supplied hypothesis
part, separately. Return each part exactly once with a nonempty `findings` array.
Each finding groups only statements that have the same relation to that part and
contains `relation`, `statement_ids`, `relevance_status` (direct, indirect,
unrelated, uncertain), `rationale`, `inference_bridge` (for supports,
consistent_with, weakens, or contradicts: one nonempty sentence stating how the
quoted statement bears on the claim; for any other relation: an empty string), `scope_alignment` (match, mismatch, unknown), and `time_alignment` (match,
mismatch, unknown). Separate supporting passages from contradictory passages;
never collapse conflicting evidence into one finding. For incident claims, use
unknown when the passage does not establish incident scope or time. A mismatch
means the passage concerns a different event, time, or scope. Distinguish general
or conditional mechanisms from incident events and incident causal links. A
statement that something can happen does not show that it happened here. A
procedure states what should happen, not what did happen. A negated statement
cannot support the positive event it negates. Absence from this packet is not
contradiction. Do not assign truth, root cause, probability, or global confidence.

Relations:
- supports: the statement shows what the part says, all of it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Show the status of every claim and link on a saved run's board, and its causal chains.

Uses the same rules as the Lead (``cferp/status.py``) and needs no model. Boards from
before v0.5 have no claim parts, no origin records and only ``neutral`` for passages
that settle nothing, so each claim reads as one part, each document as its own source,
and ``neutral`` as ``open``.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from cferp.status import board_status  # noqa: E402


def render(report: dict, view: dict, max_paths: int) -> str:
    texts = {c["claim_id"]: c.get("text", "") for c in report["board"]["claims"]}
    docs = {m["material_id"]: m.get("title", m["material_id"]).removesuffix(".md")
            for m in report["board"].get("materials", ())}
    out = [f"claims by status: {view['claims_by_status']}", f"links by status:  {view['links_by_status']}", ""]
    order = ["reported", "shown", "partly shown", "contested", "contradicted", "open", "unchecked"]
    for status in order:
        rows = [r for r in view["claims"].values() if r["status"] == status]
        if not rows:
            continue
        out.append(f"{status.upper()} ({len(rows)})")
        for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["claim_id"]):
            src = sorted({docs.get(s, s) for p in r["parts"] for s in p["support_sources"]})
            con = sorted({docs.get(s, s) for p in r["parts"] for s in p["contradict_sources"]})
            extra = (f" supports {','.join(src)}" if src else "") + (f" contradicts {','.join(con)}" if con else "")
            out.append(f"  {r['claim_id']}: {texts.get(r['claim_id'], '')[:90]}{extra}  {r['assessments_by_effect']}")
        out.append("")
    chains = view["chains"]
    paths = chains["paths"]
    out.append(f"CHAINS: {len(paths)} paths from the incident{' (truncated)' if chains['truncated'] else ''}; "
               f"{len(chains['claims_on_no_path'])} claims on no path")
    out.append(f"  weakest claim on each path: {dict(Counter(p['weakest_claim']['status'] for p in paths))}")
    # Two links between the same claims give two paths; print each chain of claims once.
    chains_seen = Counter()
    for p in paths:
        chains_seen[" <- ".join(f"{i}[{s}]" for (k, i), s in zip(p["steps"], p["statuses"]) if k == "claim")] += 1
    for line, n in list(chains_seen.items())[:max_paths]:
        out.append(f"  {line}{f'  (x{n}, by different links)' if n > 1 else ''}")
    if chains["claims_on_no_path"]:
        out.append("  on no path: " + ", ".join(chains["claims_on_no_path"]))
    return "\n".join(out)

"""Scenario checks for the complete standalone CFERP workflow layer."""
from dataclasses import replace
import unittest

from cferp import CFERPWorkflow, RoleResult
from cferp.contracts import (
    CandidateAction, EvidencePacket, InformationSlot, JobState, Need, NeedState, OutwardRequest,
    RequestDisposition, Role, SlotState,
)
from cferp.engine import CFERPError
from cferp.workflow import (
    AssessmentEffect, BranchState, CaseState, MaterialRecord,
)


def setup_workflow():
    wf = CFERPWorkflow("CASE-9")
    wf.register_material(event_id="MAT-E1", material=MaterialRecord(
        "DOC-1", "v1", "hash-1", "Hydraulic manual", "manual",
        content="A leaking valve can cause hydraulic pressure loss."))
    assignments = wf.initialize_case(
        event_id="CASE-E1",
        case_packet={"reported_claims": [{"claim_id": "H0", "text": "Carrier beam fell", "kind": "case_claim"}]},
        specialist_profiles=(
            {"profile_id": "mechanical", "cues": ["carrier beam"], "direction": "develop mechanical alternatives"},
            {"profile_id": "electrical", "cues": ["motor"], "direction": "develop electrical alternatives"},
            {"profile_id": "other", "cues": [], "direction": "check undocumented alternatives"},
        ),
    )
    return wf, assignments[0]


class CFERPWorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_semantic_assignment_refinement_cannot_expand_lead_scope(self):
        class Assistant:
            def suggest_matches(self, kind, candidate, existing):
                return ()

            def clarify_assignment(self, assignment):
                return {"purpose": "clarify the valve configuration",
                        "target_ids": assignment.target_ids,
                        "need_ids": assignment.need_ids,
                        "context_additions": {"routing_note": "configuration ambiguity"}}

        wf, specialist = setup_workflow()
        wf.semantic_assistant = Assistant()
        refined = wf.refine_ambiguous_assignment(specialist.assignment_id)
        self.assertEqual(refined.purpose, "clarify the valve configuration")
        self.assertEqual(refined.target_ids, specialist.target_ids)
        self.assertEqual(refined.context["routing_note"], "configuration ambiguity")
        self.assertEqual(refined.context["refined_from"], specialist.assignment_id)
        self.assertEqual(wf.lead.work[specialist.assignment_id].state, JobState.SUPERSEDED)
        self.assertNotIn(specialist.assignment_id, {a.assignment_id for a in wf.schedule()})

        class ScopeExpander(Assistant):
            def clarify_assignment(self, assignment):
                return {"target_ids": ("unassigned-claim",)}

        wf.semantic_assistant = ScopeExpander()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CFERPError, "cannot expand assignment targets"):
            wf.refine_ambiguous_assignment(refined.assignment_id)

    def test_semantic_refinement_is_discarded_if_snapshot_changes_during_call(self):
        wf, specialist = setup_workflow()

        class MutatingAssistant:
            def suggest_matches(self, kind, candidate, existing):
                return ()

            def clarify_assignment(self, assignment):
                wf.lead.ingest_event("BOARD-CHANGED-IN-CALL", "board_changed",
                                     {"changed_dependency_ids": ("H0",)})
                return {"purpose": "stale refined work"}

        wf.semantic_assistant = MutatingAssistant()
        before = set(wf.assignments)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CFERPError, "snapshot changed while"):
            wf.refine_ambiguous_assignment(specialist.assignment_id)
        self.assertEqual(set(wf.assignments), before)
        self.assertEqual(wf.lead.work[specialist.assignment_id].state, JobState.STALE)

    def test_later_need_reuses_completed_search_with_separate_assessor_review(self):
        wf, specialist = setup_workflow()
        wf.start_assignment(specialist.assignment_id)
        slot = {"slot_id": "s1", "description": "pin inspection record", "entity_id": "valve-1",
                "time_scope": "incident", "record_type": "inspection"}
        created = wf.submit_specialist_result(RoleResult("SR-1", specialist.assignment_id,
            Role.SPECIALIST, specialist.manifest,
            {"claims": [{"claim_id": "H1", "text": "A valve leaked", "branch_id": "B1",
                "kind": "incident_event", "parent_claim_ids": ["H0"]}],
             "needs": [{"need_id": "N1", "target_ids": ["H1"], "source_scope": ["DOC-1"],
                        "slots": [slot]}]}))
        worker = next(a for a in created if a.role == Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER)
        wf.start_assignment(worker.assignment_id)
        versions = wf.lead.manifest().source_versions
        link = {"claim_id": "H1", "need_ids": ["N1"], "material_id": "DOC-1", "material_version": "v1",
                "passage_id": "p1", "exact_text": "A leaking valve can cause hydraulic pressure loss."}
        reviewers = wf.submit_worker_result(RoleResult("EW-1", worker.assignment_id, Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER,
            worker.manifest, {"packets": [{"packet_id": "P-N1", "target_ids": ["H1"],
                "covered_slot_ids": ["s1"], "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "entity_ids": ["valve-1"],
                "time_scope": "incident", "record_types": ["inspection"], "source_versions": versions,
                "candidate_links": [link]}]}))
        evidence_review = next(a for a in reviewers if a.context.get("task_kind") == "evidence_review")
        wf.start_assignment(evidence_review.assignment_id)

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from cferp import CFERPWorkflow, RoleResult
from cferp.contracts import Role
from cferp.integration import hera_result_to_cferp, hera_task_from_cferp
from cferp.status import board_status
from cferp.workflow import AssessmentEffect, MaterialRecord
from hera1 import Hera1Engine

PASSAGE = "The B hydraulic supply was isolated at 11:10 on the switching sheet."
CLAIM = "Valve IV-RB3-17 was isolated at 11:10."
PARTS = ["Valve IV-RB3-17", "was isolated", "at 11:10"]


def workflow():
    wf = CFERPWorkflow("CASE-9")
    wf.register_material(event_id="MAT-E1", material=MaterialRecord(
        "DOC-1", "v1", "hash-1", "Switching sheet", "record", content=PASSAGE))
    specialist = wf.initialize_case(
        event_id="CASE-E1",
        case_packet={"reported_claims": [{"claim_id": "H0", "text": "Carrier beam fell", "kind": "case_claim"}]},
        specialist_profiles=({"profile_id": "other", "cues": [], "direction": "check alternatives"},))[0]
    wf.start_assignment(specialist.assignment_id)
    return wf, specialist


def propose(wf, specialist, claims):
    slot = {"slot_id": "s1", "description": "isolation record", "entity_id": "valve",
            "time_scope": "incident", "record_type": "record"}
    return wf.submit_specialist_result(RoleResult("SR-1", specialist.assignment_id, Role.SPECIALIST,
        specialist.manifest, {"claims": claims,
            "needs": [{"need_id": "N1", "target_ids": ["V"], "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "slots": [slot]}]}))


def claim(cid, text, **extra):
    return {"claim_id": cid, "text": text, "branch_id": "B1", "kind": "component_state",
            "parent_claim_ids": ["H0"], **extra}


def review_assignment(wf, created):
    worker = next(a for a in created if a.role == Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER)
    wf.start_assignment(worker.assignment_id)
    link = {"claim_id": "V", "need_ids": ["N1"], "material_id": "DOC-1", "material_version": "v1",
            "passage_id": "p1", "exact_text": PASSAGE, "start_offset": 0, "end_offset": len(PASSAGE)}
    reviewers = wf.submit_worker_result(RoleResult("EW-1", worker.assignment_id, Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER,
        worker.manifest, {"packets": [{"packet_id": "P-N1", "target_ids": ["V"], "covered_slot_ids": ["s1"],
            "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "entity_ids": ["valve"], "time_scope": "incident",
            "record_types": ["record"], "source_versions": wf.lead.manifest().source_versions,
            "candidate_links": [link]}]}))
    review = next(a for a in reviewers if a.context.get("task_kind") == "evidence_review")
    wf.start_assignment(review.assignment_id)
    return review


def finding(relation, statement_ids=("s1",)):
    bridge = "it bears on the part" if relation in {"supports", "consistent_with", "weakens", "contradicts"} else ""
    return {"relation": relation, "statement_ids": list(statement_ids), "rationale": relation,
            "inference_bridge": bridge, "relevance_status": "direct",
            "scope_alignment": "match", "time_alignment": "match"}

    def test_parts_and_denials_reach_the_board(self):
        wf, specialist = workflow()
        propose(wf, specialist, [claim("V", CLAIM, parts=PARTS),
                                 claim("NOT-V", "Valve IV-RB3-17 was not isolated.", denies=["V", "GHOST", "NOT-V"])])
        self.assertEqual(wf.claims["V"].parts, tuple(PARTS))
        self.assertEqual(wf.claims["NOT-V"].denies, ("V",))  # unknown and self-denial dropped

    def setUp(self):
        self.wf, specialist = workflow()
        created = propose(self.wf, specialist, [claim("V", CLAIM, parts=PARTS)])
        self.review = review_assignment(self.wf, created)
        self.task = hera_task_from_cferp(self.review, self.wf)

    def test_one_assessor_part_per_claim_part_with_the_whole_claim_beside_it(self):
        parts = self.task.hypothesis["parts"]
        self.assertEqual([p["text"] for p in parts], PARTS)
        self.assertEqual({p["claim_text"] for p in parts}, {CLAIM})
        # a component state is an incident fact, so the Assessor's incident checks apply
        self.assertEqual({p["claim_type"] for p in parts}, {"incident_fact"})

    def test_each_row_names_its_part_and_keeps_the_assessors_answer(self):
        parts = self.task.hypothesis["parts"]
        statement = {"statement_id": "s1", "material_id": "p1", "source_id": "DOC-1", "source_version": "v1",
                     "representation_id": "DOC-1:v1:text", "quote": PASSAGE, "start_offset": 0,
                     "kind": "incident_observation", "modality": "asserted", "scope": "incident",
                     "timing": "incident"}
        compared = {"parts": [
            {"part_id": parts[0]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("does_not_address")]},
            {"part_id": parts[1]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("supports")]},
            {"part_id": parts[2]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("supports")]}]}
        versions = FixedVersions(self.task.case_snapshot_id, self.task.board_version, {"DOC-1": "v1"})
        result = Hera1Engine(ScriptedModel([{"statements": [statement]}, compared]), versions).run(self.task)
        self.wf.submit_assessor_result(hera_result_to_cferp(result, self.task, self.review))
        stored = sorted((a.part, a.effect) for a in self.wf.assessments.values())
        self.assertEqual(stored, [("Valve IV-RB3-17", AssessmentEffect.NOT_RELEVANT),
                                  ("at 11:10", AssessmentEffect.SUPPORTS),
                                  ("was isolated", AssessmentEffect.SUPPORTS)])
        row = board_status({"claims": tuple(self.wf.claims.values()),
                            "assessments": tuple(self.wf.assessments.values())}, origins={})["claims"]["V"]
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "partly shown")
        self.assertEqual(row["missing_parts"], ["Valve IV-RB3-17"])


class StatusView(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_passage_supporting_a_claim_and_its_denial_is_flagged(self):
        board = {"claims": [{"claim_id": "UP", "text": "raised"},
                            {"claim_id": "DOWN", "text": "not raised", "denies": ["UP"]}],
                 "assessments": [{"claim_id": c, "material_id": "E05", "passage_id": "p7", "effect": "supports"}
                                 for c in ("UP", "DOWN")]}
        self.assertEqual(board_status(board, origins={})["denial_conflicts"],
                         [{"material_id": "E05", "passage_id": "p7", "claims": ["DOWN", "UP"]}])

    def test_origins_come_from_the_materials_text_when_not_given(self):
        board = {"claims": [{"claim_id": "C", "text": "seepage at closed"}],
                 "materials": [{"material_id": "E08", "content": "Workshop tag VAL-17. Seepage at closed."},
                               {"material_id": "E16", "content": "Prepared from workshop record VAL-17."}],
                 "assessments": [{"claim_id": "C", "material_id": m, "effect": "supports"} for m in ("E08", "E16")]}
        view = board_status(board)
        self.assertEqual(view["origins"], {"E16": "E08"})
        self.assertEqual(view["claims"]["C"]["independent_sources"], 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    slot = {"slot_id": "s1", "description": "isolation record", "entity_id": "valve",
            "time_scope": "incident", "record_type": "record"}

    return {"claim_id": cid, "text": text, "branch_id": "B1", "kind": "component_state",

**Done in the Lead:**
- **Parts and denials reach the board.** Claims on the board now keep the Specialist's `parts` and `denies`. A denial that names an unknown claim, or the claim itself, is dropped. When a claim is merged into an existing one as a duplicate, its denials point at the existing claim.

import unittest

from cferp.contracts import Role
from cferp.integration import hera_result_to_cferp, hera_task_from_cferp
from cferp.status import board_status
from cferp.workflow import AssessmentEffect, MaterialRecord
from hera1 import Hera1Engine

from test_hera1 import FixedVersions, ScriptedModel

PASSAGE = "The B hydraulic supply was isolated at 11:10 on the switching sheet."
CLAIM = "Valve IV-RB3-17 was isolated at 11:10."
PARTS = ["Valve IV-RB3-17", "was isolated", "at 11:10"]


def workflow():
    wf = CFERPWorkflow("CASE-9")
    wf.register_material(event_id="MAT-E1", material=MaterialRecord(
        "DOC-1", "v1", "hash-1", "Switching sheet", "record", content=PASSAGE))
    specialist = wf.initialize_case(
        event_id="CASE-E1",
        case_packet={"reported_claims": [{"claim_id": "H0", "text": "Carrier beam fell", "kind": "case_claim"}]},
        specialist_profiles=({"profile_id": "other", "cues": [], "direction": "check alternatives"},))[0]
    wf.start_assignment(specialist.assignment_id)
    return wf, specialist


def propose(wf, specialist, claims):
    slot = {"slot_id": "s1", "description": "isolation record", "entity_id": "valve",
            "time_scope": "incident", "record_type": "record"}
    return wf.submit_specialist_result(RoleResult("SR-1", specialist.assignment_id, Role.SPECIALIST,
        specialist.manifest, {"claims": claims,
            "needs": [{"need_id": "N1", "target_ids": ["V"], "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "slots": [slot]}]}))


def claim(cid, text, **extra):
    return {"claim_id": cid, "text": text, "branch_id": "B1", "kind": "component_state",
            "parent_claim_ids": ["H0"], **extra}


def review_assignment(wf, created):
    worker = next(a for a in created if a.role == Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER)
    wf.start_assignment(worker.assignment_id)
    link = {"claim_id": "V", "need_ids": ["N1"], "material_id": "DOC-1", "material_version": "v1",
            "passage_id": "p1", "exact_text": PASSAGE, "start_offset": 0, "end_offset": len(PASSAGE)}
    reviewers = wf.submit_worker_result(RoleResult("EW-1", worker.assignment_id, Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER,
        worker.manifest, {"packets": [{"packet_id": "P-N1", "target_ids": ["V"], "covered_slot_ids": ["s1"],
            "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "entity_ids": ["valve"], "time_scope": "incident",
            "record_types": ["record"], "source_versions": wf.lead.manifest().source_versions,
            "candidate_links": [link]}]}))
    review = next(a for a in reviewers if a.context.get("task_kind") == "evidence_review")
    wf.start_assignment(review.assignment_id)
    return review


def finding(relation, statement_ids=("s1",)):
    bridge = "it bears on the part" if relation in {"supports", "consistent_with", "weakens", "contradicts"} else ""
    return {"relation": relation, "statement_ids": list(statement_ids), "rationale": relation,
            "inference_bridge": bridge, "relevance_status": "direct",
            "scope_alignment": "match", "time_alignment": "match"}


class ClaimsCarryPartsAndDenials(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parts_and_denials_reach_the_board(self):
        wf, specialist = workflow()
        propose(wf, specialist, [claim("V", CLAIM, parts=PARTS),
                                 claim("NOT-V", "Valve IV-RB3-17 was not isolated.", denies=["V", "GHOST", "NOT-V"])])
        self.assertEqual(wf.claims["V"].parts, tuple(PARTS))
        self.assertEqual(wf.claims["NOT-V"].denies, ("V",))  # unknown and self-denial dropped


class AssessorGetsEachPart(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.wf, specialist = workflow()
        created = propose(self.wf, specialist, [claim("V", CLAIM, parts=PARTS)])
        self.review = review_assignment(self.wf, created)
        self.task = hera_task_from_cferp(self.review, self.wf)

    def test_one_assessor_part_per_claim_part_with_the_whole_claim_beside_it(self):
        parts = self.task.hypothesis["parts"]
        self.assertEqual([p["text"] for p in parts], PARTS)
        self.assertEqual({p["claim_text"] for p in parts}, {CLAIM})
        # a component state is an incident fact, so the Assessor's incident checks apply
        self.assertEqual({p["claim_type"] for p in parts}, {"incident_fact"})

    def test_each_row_names_its_part_and_keeps_the_assessors_answer(self):
        parts = self.task.hypothesis["parts"]
        statement = {"statement_id": "s1", "material_id": "p1", "source_id": "DOC-1", "source_version": "v1",
                     "representation_id": "DOC-1:v1:text", "quote": PASSAGE, "start_offset": 0,
                     "kind": "incident_observation", "modality": "asserted", "scope": "incident",
                     "timing": "incident"}
        compared = {"parts": [
            {"part_id": parts[0]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("does_not_address")]},
            {"part_id": parts[1]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("supports")]},
            {"part_id": parts[2]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("supports")]}]}
        versions = FixedVersions(self.task.case_snapshot_id, self.task.board_version, {"DOC-1": "v1"})
        result = Hera1Engine(ScriptedModel([{"statements": [statement]}, compared]), versions).run(self.task)
        self.wf.submit_assessor_result(hera_result_to_cferp(result, self.task, self.review))
        stored = sorted((a.part, a.effect) for a in self.wf.assessments.values())
        self.assertEqual(stored, [("Valve IV-RB3-17", AssessmentEffect.NOT_RELEVANT),
                                  ("at 11:10", AssessmentEffect.SUPPORTS),
                                  ("was isolated", AssessmentEffect.SUPPORTS)])
        row = board_status({"claims": tuple(self.wf.claims.values()),
                            "assessments": tuple(self.wf.assessments.values())}, origins={})["claims"]["V"]
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "partly shown")
        self.assertEqual(row["missing_parts"], ["Valve IV-RB3-17"])


class StatusView(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_passage_supporting_a_claim_and_its_denial_is_flagged(self):
        board = {"claims": [{"claim_id": "UP", "text": "raised"},
                            {"claim_id": "DOWN", "text": "not raised", "denies": ["UP"]}],
                 "assessments": [{"claim_id": c, "material_id": "E05", "passage_id": "p7", "effect": "supports"}
                                 for c in ("UP", "DOWN")]}
        self.assertEqual(board_status(board, origins={})["denial_conflicts"],
                         [{"material_id": "E05", "passage_id": "p7", "claims": ["DOWN", "UP"]}])

    def test_origins_come_from_the_materials_text_when_not_given(self):
        board = {"claims": [{"claim_id": "C", "text": "seepage at closed"}],
                 "materials": [{"material_id": "E08", "content": "Workshop tag VAL-17. Seepage at closed."},

        view = board_status(board)
        self.assertEqual(view["origins"], {"E16": "E08"})
        self.assertEqual(view["claims"]["C"]["independent_sources"], 1)

### Repeating a run

.venv/bin/python V3_Neurosymbolic_Inspired/scripts/run_repeats.py \
  --model gpt-oss:20b --runs 3 --output-prefix outputs/exp_name

Runs the same configuration N times, scores each, and reports mean, minimum and maximum
plus how much the runs agree (same nodes covered, same key sentences assessed). Raw model
responses are dropped from the saved files unless `--keep-raw` is given.

Use the project interpreter (`.venv/bin/python`, which has `clingo`). Run the Ollama
adapter tests with `PYTHONPATH=V1_V2_Prompt_and_Rules/source/RCA_Version_Labeled_Codebase`.

## Troubleshooting

- **Ollama connection refused:** start Ollama, verify `ollama list`, and use the
  exact installed model tag and local API URL.
- **Clingo import/solver error:** install `requirements-sahs.txt` in the same
  Python environment used to run the script. SAHS does not silently replace the
  configured solver.
- **Malformed custodian response:** inspect the `synthetic_custodian_response`
  call in `model_calls`. The runner requires exactly two arrays and rejects IDs
  outside the supplied item/slot lists.
- **Provider error or timeout:** inspect `run_metadata.failure` and the last
  model call. The runner preserves a diagnostic snapshot where possible; it
  does not invent a role result to continue.
- **Open work after execution:** inspect `role_jobs_remaining`, `work`, open

Its question reads: Evidence that "Valve IV-RB3-17" holds, in the claim "Valve IV-RB3-17 was isolated at 11:10."

content.text:
The first real-model run was much worse than the earlier "32k low" run. I traced it to my Specialist change, made a fix, and started a second run. That run is still going and has no results yet.

| | 32k low (before) | v0.5 run 1 |
|---|---|---|
| Claims on the board | 29 | 12 |
| Causal links | 41 | 0 |
| Key sentences assessed | 17/23 | 12/23 |
| Documents assessed | 14/16 | 11/16 |
| Specialist failures | 2 | 9 |

**Cause:** I had made every claim come with its `parts` and `denies`, which roughly doubled the length of the Specialist's answers. At that length gpt-oss:20b sometimes starts repeating itself. One answer listed 122 claims, mostly "Measured velocity supports the risk assessment" and "..." over and over.
- **No board:** 4 answers went over the 40-claim limit and were rejected, including the first three, which set up the board. So the board never got its initial claims or links.
- **Timeouts:** 5 more answers timed out because they ran too long.
- **Never seen before:** no earlier run had more than 7 claims in one answer.
- **Parts were split badly:** the model split even simple claims into two parts, such as "The carrier" / "was left high for clearance…".

**What I didn't change:** I didn't cap the answer size. I checked that Ollama does enforce a size limit. But the model then crammed the rest of its list into one broken entry, so a capped answer would let a bad claim onto the board instead of being rejected openly.

**Fix:** `parts` and `denies` are now optional in the answer format. The prompt asks for parts only when a claim joins several facts that each need their own evidence, and for denials only when one claim says another is false. All 499 tests still pass.

**What worked in run 1:**
- The Assessor's answers came through as they are (63 `not_relevant`, 7 `insufficient`, 2 `consistent_with`).
- The Lead recorded 7 claim status changes.
- The traps still held: E16 wasn't counted alongside E08, and E13 didn't support the original keeper claim.

**Second run:** it uses the same settings and saves to `outputs/v05step1b_reserve32k_efflow_gpt-oss-20b_fixedcustodian_run1.json`. When it finishes I'll score it against the earlier run and check it for loops, missing-part needs and denial conflicts.

**Labels needed:** the new claims have no labels in `claim_node_labels.json`, so their node coverage comes only from word overlap. I'll need to label them before that number means anything.

   The user is an RCA researcher building a closed-loop RCA harness.

     - Check every document against every claim.
     - Ask for missing evidence.
     - Never declare an unsupported root cause.
     - Produce the same board regardless of arrival order.
     - Compare two models fairly, with the model under test (gpt-oss:20b) doing everything in the pipeline.

   Requests in this segment, in order:
   - **"Yes, Intake next":** origin records. Done.
   - **"Yes, Lead next":** wire the Lead last, following the earlier instruction "we first do the individual components and take on the central lead last". Done.
   - **"lets do this than":** do the remaining items. These were:

     3. missing parts → needs, and status changes as Lead events;

   **Standing constraints (preserve):**
   - Do not install packages or pull models without asking.
   - Do not publish or send anything externally without asking. Push to GitHub only on explicit request.

   - Memory rule: build components first and the Lead last (`memory/components-before-lead.md`).

2. **Key Technical Concepts**
   - **Origins:** a map from derived material to original. It is worked out over the whole case each time it is asked, so arrival order doesn't matter. The identifier must appear in the other document outside that document's own origin sentences; when two documents carry it, it is ambiguous and left unmatched.
   - **Claim parts:**
     - A claim with two or more parts goes to HERA as one hypothesis part per claim part, each with `claim_text` (the whole claim) and `claim_part`.
     - Each assessment row records `part`.
     - In `status._marks`, a row's `part` applies its effect to that part only.
   - **Effects:**
     - HERA relation → Lead effect:
       - supports, weakens, contradicts unchanged;
       - consistent_with → consistent_with;
       - insufficient_or_unclear → insufficient;
       - does_not_address → not_relevant;
       - no extraction → not_relevant.
     - `neutral` stays valid for old boards.
   - **Claim types:** `component_state` and `unknown_condition` go to HERA as `incident_fact`. HERA's incident checks then require scope and time "match" for a support.
   - **Denial conflicts:** a passage (material_id plus passage_id) that supports both claims of a denial pair.
   - **Lead after each Assessor result:**
     - works out the touched claims' status;
     - records a `claim_status_changed` event (event kinds other than the versioned ones don't bump the board version);
     - for a `partly shown` claim, opens need `part:<claim>:<n>` with origin_kind `missing_claim_part`, which queues an Evidence Worker search.
   - **Ollama and runs:**
     - Ollama 0.32.3 uses the "schema" format for constrained decoding. It honours `maxItems`, but the model then crams overflow into a broken string, so I decided not to cap.
     - The project Python is `.venv/bin/python` (it has clingo). The test command is:
       `PYTHONPATH=V3_Neurosymbolic_Inspired:V3_Neurosymbolic_Inspired/tests .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s V3_Neurosymbolic_Inspired/tests -t V3_Neurosymbolic_Inspired`
     - Exit code 2 from `run_v3_closed_loop.py` means "completed_with_job_failures".

3. **Files and Code Sections**

   - **`piris/origins.py`** (new)
     - Regexes:
       - `_ORIGIN` matches prepared, compiled, transcribed, copied, summarised, derived, reproduced, extracted or abstracted followed by "from" within 80 characters; or "based on"; or "^source:".
       - `_SENTENCE` splits text into sentences.
       - `_CODE` matches hyphenated codes such as VAL-17.
       - `_NAMED` matches "record|report|document|sheet|log|docket|tag|form|file|note|summary <id with a digit>".
     - Dataclasses:
       - `OriginStatement(material_id, quote, start_offset, identifiers)`;
       - `OriginMap(origins, statements, unresolved, ambiguous, unnamed)`.
     - Functions:
       - `identifiers_in`;
       - `origin_statements(material_id, text)`;
       - `_carries(text, identifier, skip)`, a whole-token match outside the document's own origin spans;
       - `resolve_origins(texts: Mapping[str,str]) -> OriginMap`;
       - `material_text`;
       - `case_origins(materials)`, which excludes versions replaced by a revision.
     - On the 16 fixtures (`V1_V2_Prompt_and_Rules/source/RCA_Version_Labeled_Codebase/tests/v2_regression/fixtures/evidence/`) it gives `{'E16': 'E08'}`. E16's "morning briefing…Day +3" sentence is reported as unnamed.
   - **`piris/engine.py`:** imports `OriginMap, case_origins`; adds `IntakeEngine.case_origins(self, case_id)`, which runs over `self.store.materials_for_case(case_id)`.
   - **`piris/__init__.py`:** exports OriginMap, OriginStatement, case_origins and resolve_origins.
   - **`tests/test_piris_origins.py`** (new, 9 tests), in three groups:
     - Statements;
     - Matching: identifier matched, VAL-170 doesn't match VAL-17, two carriers are ambiguous, two recaps don't match each other;
     - ArrivalOrder: recap first is unresolved and then matched, and either order gives the same map.
   - **`cferp/workflow.py`**
     - AssessmentEffect adds CONSISTENT_WITH, INSUFFICIENT and NOT_RELEVANT; NEUTRAL is kept with a comment.
     - `Claim` adds `parts: tuple[str,...] = ()` and `denies: tuple[str,...] = ()`.
     - `AssessmentRecord` adds `part: str = ""`.
     - Claim creation in `submit_specialist_result` adds the parts, and denies filtered to known claims (on the board or in this batch) and not the claim itself. `batch_ids` is computed after folding.
     - `_fold_duplicates` renames "denies" too.
     - Reassessment supersede uses `replace(prior, status="superseded_by_reassessment")`.
     - The AssessmentRecord constructor passes `part=str(row.get("part",""))`.
     - New `self.claim_statuses: dict[str,str] = {}`.
     - In `submit_assessor_result`, before `_queue_available()`, it calls `self._record_claim_statuses(affected_claims, result.result_id)` for task kinds other than request_review and clarification_review.
     - New methods:
       - `origins()`, which calls `status.material_origins` over the Lead's materials;
       - `claim_status(claim_id)`;
       - `_record_claim_statuses(claim_ids, result_id)`. It records the event `claim-status:{result_id}:{claim_id}` of kind `claim_status_changed`, with payload claim_id, from, to, missing_parts, independent_sources and sources_assumed_independent. It also opens part needs:
         ```python
         need_id = f"part:{claim_id}:{claim.parts.index(part) + 1}"
         if need_id in self.lead.needs: continue
         self.lead.add_need(Need(need_id, "missing_claim_part", claim_id, (claim_id,), (
             InformationSlot(f"{need_id}:slot", f'Evidence that "{part}" holds, in the claim "{claim.text}"'),)))
         ```
   - **`cferp/integration.py`**
     - New constants:
       - `NO_EVIDENCE_EFFECTS = {"neutral","not_relevant","rejected_link"}`, used in `specialist_annotations` ranking;
       - `HERA_EFFECTS`, the relation map above.

     - `_evidence_rows`:
       - uses `part_text = source_part.get("claim_part","")`;
       - maps effects via HERA_EFFECTS;
       - for a finding with no statements and an effect other than supports, weakens or contradicts, emits `_unrelated_assigned_row(..., effect=effect, part=part_text)`;

"""Lead changes for v0.5 Step 1: claim parts and denials on the board, one Assessor part
per claim part, the Assessor's answers kept as they are, denial conflicts and origins."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from cferp import CFERPWorkflow, RoleResult
from cferp.contracts import Role
from cferp.integration import hera_result_to_cferp, hera_task_from_cferp
from cferp.status import board_status
from cferp.workflow import AssessmentEffect, MaterialRecord
from hera1 import Hera1Engine

from test_hera1 import FixedVersions, ScriptedModel

PASSAGE = "The B hydraulic supply was isolated at 11:10 on the switching sheet."
CLAIM = "Valve IV-RB3-17 was isolated at 11:10."
PARTS = ["Valve IV-RB3-17", "was isolated", "at 11:10"]


def workflow():
    wf = CFERPWorkflow("CASE-9")
    wf.register_material(event_id="MAT-E1", material=MaterialRecord(
        "DOC-1", "v1", "hash-1", "Switching sheet", "record", content=PASSAGE))
    specialist = wf.initialize_case(
        event_id="CASE-E1",
        case_packet={"reported_claims": [{"claim_id": "H0", "text": "Carrier beam fell", "kind": "case_claim"}]},
        specialist_profiles=({"profile_id": "other", "cues": [], "direction": "check alternatives"},))[0]
    wf.start_assignment(specialist.assignment_id)
    return wf, specialist


def propose(wf, specialist, claims):
    slot = {"slot_id": "s1", "description": "isolation record", "entity_id": "valve",
            "time_scope": "incident", "record_type": "record"}
    return wf.submit_specialist_result(RoleResult("SR-1", specialist.assignment_id, Role.SPECIALIST,
        specialist.manifest, {"claims": claims,
            "needs": [{"need_id": "N1", "target_ids": ["V"], "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "slots": [slot]}]}))


def claim(cid, text, **extra):
    return {"claim_id": cid, "text": text, "branch_id": "B1", "kind": "component_state",
            "parent_claim_ids": ["H0"], **extra}


def review_assignment(wf, created):
    worker = next(a for a in created if a.role == Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER)
    wf.start_assignment(worker.assignment_id)
    link = {"claim_id": "V", "need_ids": ["N1"], "material_id": "DOC-1", "material_version": "v1",
            "passage_id": "p1", "exact_text": PASSAGE, "start_offset": 0, "end_offset": len(PASSAGE)}
    reviewers = wf.submit_worker_result(RoleResult("EW-1", worker.assignment_id, Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER,
        worker.manifest, {"packets": [{"packet_id": "P-N1", "target_ids": ["V"], "covered_slot_ids": ["s1"],
            "source_scope": ["DOC-1"], "entity_ids": ["valve"], "time_scope": "incident",
            "record_types": ["record"], "source_versions": wf.lead.manifest().source_versions,
            "candidate_links": [link]}]}))
    review = next(a for a in reviewers if a.context.get("task_kind") == "evidence_review")
    wf.start_assignment(review.assignment_id)
    return review


def finding(relation, statement_ids=("s1",)):
    bridge = "it bears on the part" if relation in {"supports", "consistent_with", "weakens", "contradicts"} else ""
    return {"relation": relation, "statement_ids": list(statement_ids), "rationale": relation,
            "inference_bridge": bridge, "relevance_status": "direct",
            "scope_alignment": "match", "time_alignment": "match"}


class ClaimsCarryPartsAndDenials(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parts_and_denials_reach_the_board(self):
        wf, specialist = workflow()
        propose(wf, specialist, [claim("V", CLAIM, parts=PARTS),
                                 claim("NOT-V", "Valve IV-RB3-17 was not isolated.", denies=["V", "GHOST", "NOT-V"])])
        self.assertEqual(wf.claims["V"].parts, tuple(PARTS))
        self.assertEqual(wf.claims["NOT-V"].denies, ("V",))  # unknown and self-denial dropped


class AssessorGetsEachPart(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.wf, specialist = workflow()
        created = propose(self.wf, specialist, [claim("V", CLAIM, parts=PARTS)])
        self.review = review_assignment(self.wf, created)
        self.task = hera_task_from_cferp(self.review, self.wf)

    def test_one_assessor_part_per_claim_part_with_the_whole_claim_beside_it(self):
        parts = self.task.hypothesis["parts"]
        self.assertEqual([p["text"] for p in parts], PARTS)
        self.assertEqual({p["claim_text"] for p in parts}, {CLAIM})
        # a component state is an incident fact, so the Assessor's incident checks apply
        self.assertEqual({p["claim_type"] for p in parts}, {"incident_fact"})

    def test_each_row_names_its_part_and_keeps_the_assessors_answer(self):
        parts = self.task.hypothesis["parts"]
        statement = {"statement_id": "s1", "material_id": "p1", "source_id": "DOC-1", "source_version": "v1",
                     "representation_id": "DOC-1:v1:text", "quote": PASSAGE, "start_offset": 0,
                     "kind": "incident_observation", "modality": "asserted", "scope": "incident",
                     "timing": "incident"}
        compared = {"parts": [
            {"part_id": parts[0]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("does_not_address")]},
            {"part_id": parts[1]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("supports")]},
            {"part_id": parts[2]["part_id"], "findings": [finding("supports")]}]}
        versions = FixedVersions(self.task.case_snapshot_id, self.task.board_version, {"DOC-1": "v1"})
        result = Hera1Engine(ScriptedModel([{"statements": [statement]}, compared]), versions).run(self.task)
        self.wf.submit_assessor_result(hera_result_to_cferp(result, self.task, self.review))
        stored = sorted((a.part, a.effect) for a in self.wf.assessments.values())
        self.assertEqual(stored, [("Valve IV-RB3-17", AssessmentEffect.NOT_RELEVANT),
                                  ("at 11:10", AssessmentEffect.SUPPORTS),
                                  ("was isolated", AssessmentEffect.SUPPORTS)])
        row = board_status({"claims": tuple(self.wf.claims.values()),
                            "assessments": tuple(self.wf.assessments.values())}, origins={})["claims"]["V"]
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "partly shown")
        self.assertEqual(row["missing_parts"], ["Valve IV-RB3-17"])

        # The Lead records the change and opens a need for the missing part, once.
        changes = [e.payload for e in self.wf.lead.events if e.kind == "claim_status_changed"]
        self.assertEqual([(c["claim_id"], c["from"], c["to"]) for c in changes], [("V", None, "partly shown")])
        need = self.wf.lead.needs["part:V:1"]
        self.assertEqual((need.origin_kind, need.target_ids), ("missing_claim_part", ("V",)))
        self.assertIn('"Valve IV-RB3-17"', need.slots[0].description)
        self.assertNotIn("part:V:2", self.wf.lead.needs)
        self.assertTrue(any(a.role == Role.EVIDENCE_WORKER and a.need_ids == ("part:V:1",)
                            for a in self.wf.assignments.values()))


class StatusView(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_passage_supporting_a_claim_and_its_denial_is_flagged(self):
        board = {"claims": [{"claim_id": "UP", "text": "raised"},
                            {"claim_id": "DOWN", "text": "not raised", "denies": ["UP"]}],
                 "assessments": [{"claim_id": c, "material_id": "E05", "passage_id": "p7", "effect": "supports"}
                                 for c in ("UP", "DOWN")]}
        self.assertEqual(board_status(board, origins={})["denial_conflicts"],
                         [{"material_id": "E05", "passage_id": "p7", "claims": ["DOWN", "UP"]}])

    def test_origins_come_from_the_materials_text_when_not_given(self):
        board = {"claims": [{"claim_id": "C", "text": "seepage at closed"}],
                 "materials": [{"material_id": "E08", "content": "Workshop tag VAL-17. Seepage at closed."},
                               {"material_id": "E16", "content": "Prepared from workshop record VAL-17."}],
                 "assessments": [{"claim_id": "C", "material_id": m, "effect": "supports"} for m in ("E08", "E16")]}
        view = board_status(board)
        self.assertEqual(view["origins"], {"E16": "E08"})
        self.assertEqual(view["claims"]["C"]["independent_sources"], 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Intake changes for v0.5 Step 1: origin records for documents prepared from others."""
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from cferp.status import source_of
from piris import IncomingItem, IntakeEngine, InMemoryMaterialIndexer, ParserRouter, resolve_origins
from piris.origins import origin_statements

from test_piris import assignment

WORKSHOP = ("Workshop tag VAL-17 is linked to local valve IV-RB3-17 on the removal docket. "
            "Seepage was seen with the handle at closed.")
RECAP = ("Prepared for the morning briefing from the hydraulic maintenance summary supplied on Day +3.\n"
         "The valve workshop found seepage with the isolation handle at closed.\n"
         "Prepared from workshop record VAL-17. No additional examination was conducted.")
OTHER = "Outage switching sheet UT-81. The B hydraulic supply was isolated at 11:10."


class Statements(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_origin_sentence_is_kept_word_for_word_with_its_offset(self):
        rows = origin_statements("E16", RECAP)
        named = [r for r in rows if r.identifiers]
        self.assertEqual(named[0].quote, "Prepared from workshop record VAL-17.")
        self.assertEqual(RECAP[named[0].start_offset:][:len(named[0].quote)], named[0].quote)
        self.assertEqual(named[0].identifiers, ("VAL-17",))

    def test_an_origin_that_names_no_identifier_is_reported_not_matched(self):
        result = resolve_origins({"E08": WORKSHOP, "E16": RECAP})
        self.assertEqual(len(result.unnamed), 1)
        self.assertIn("morning briefing", result.unnamed[0].quote)

    def test_a_document_that_only_mentions_a_code_has_no_origin(self):
        self.assertEqual(origin_statements("E08", WORKSHOP), ())


class Matching(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_identifier_is_matched_to_the_document_that_carries_it(self):
        result = resolve_origins({"E08": WORKSHOP, "E16": RECAP, "E10": OTHER})
        self.assertEqual(result.origins, {"E16": "E08"})
        self.assertEqual(source_of("E16", result.origins), "E08")

    def test_a_longer_code_containing_the_identifier_does_not_match(self):
        result = resolve_origins({"X": "Valve IV-RB3-17 and record VAL-170.", "E16": RECAP})
        self.assertEqual(result.origins, {})
        self.assertEqual(result.unresolved, (("E16", "VAL-17"),))

    def test_two_documents_carrying_it_are_ambiguous_and_not_matched(self):
        result = resolve_origins({"A": WORKSHOP, "B": "Bench sheet for VAL-17.", "E16": RECAP})
        self.assertEqual(result.origins, {})
        self.assertEqual(result.ambiguous, (("E16", "VAL-17", ("A", "B")),))

    def test_two_recaps_of_the_same_record_do_not_match_each_other(self):
        result = resolve_origins({"E08": WORKSHOP, "E16": RECAP, "E17": "Copied from record VAL-17 for the file."})
        self.assertEqual(result.origins, {"E16": "E08", "E17": "E08"})


class ArrivalOrder(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.engine = IntakeEngine(parser=ParserRouter(), indexer=InMemoryMaterialIndexer())

    def submit(self, sub, item_id, text):
        result = self.engine.run(assignment(sub, [IncomingItem.text(item_id, text, filename=f"{item_id}.md")]))
        return result.event.item_records[0].material_id

    def test_a_recap_that_arrives_first_is_matched_once_its_original_arrives(self):
        recap = self.submit("s1", "E16", RECAP)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.case_origins("case-1").unresolved, ((recap, "VAL-17"),))
        workshop = self.submit("s2", "E08", WORKSHOP)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.case_origins("case-1").origins, {recap: workshop})

    def test_either_order_gives_the_same_map(self):
        workshop = self.submit("s1", "E08", WORKSHOP)
        recap = self.submit("s2", "E16", RECAP)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.case_origins("case-1").origins, {recap: workshop})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

1	"""Origin records: where a document says it comes from.
2	
3	A recap that says "Prepared from workshop record VAL-17" is not a second source for what
4	VAL-17 says. Intake records each such sentence, word for word, with the identifiers it
5	names. Matching an identifier to the document that carries it is done over the whole case
6	each time it is asked, so the answer does not depend on which document arrived first: a
7	recap that arrives before its original stays unresolved until the original arrives.
8	
9	The map this produces is ``derived material -> original material``, the shape
10	``cferp.status`` takes as ``origins``. A material with no origin sentence is left out of
11	the map, so the status view shows that its independence is assumed, not known.
12	"""
13	from __future__ import annotations
14	
15	import re
16	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
17	from typing import Iterable, Mapping
18	
19	_ORIGIN = re.compile(
20	    r"\b(?:prepared|compiled|transcribed|copied|summari[sz]ed|derived|reproduced|extracted|abstracted)"
21	    r"\b[^.\n]{0,80}?\bfrom\b|\bbased\s+on\b|^\s*source\s*:",
22	    re.IGNORECASE)
23	_SENTENCE = re.compile(r"[^.!?\n]+(?:[.!?]+|$)", re.MULTILINE)
24	_CODE = re.compile(r"(?<![\w-])[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*-[A-Z0-9]*\d[A-Z0-9]*(?![\w-])")
25	_NAMED = re.compile(
26	    r"\b(?:record|report|document|sheet|log|docket|tag|form|file|note|summary)\s+"
27	    r"(?:no\.?\s*)?([A-Z0-9]*\d[A-Z0-9-]*)(?![\w-])", re.IGNORECASE)
28	
29	
30	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
31	class OriginStatement:
32	    material_id: str
33	    quote: str
34	    start_offset: int
35	    identifiers: tuple[str, ...]
36	
37	
38	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
39	class OriginMap:
40	    origins: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
41	    statements: tuple[OriginStatement, ...] = ()
42	    # (material_id, identifier) pairs that no document in the case carries yet
43	    unresolved: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = ()
44	    # (material_id, identifier, candidates) when more than one document carries it
45	    ambiguous: tuple[tuple[str, str, tuple[str, ...]], ...] = ()
46	    # origin sentences that name no identifier, so they cannot be matched
47	    unnamed: tuple[OriginStatement, ...] = ()
48	
49	
50	def identifiers_in(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
51	    found = [m.group(0) for m in _CODE.finditer(text)] + [m.group(1) for m in _NAMED.finditer(text)]
52	    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(i.upper() for i in found))
53	
54	
55	def origin_statements(material_id: str, text: str) -> tuple[OriginStatement, ...]:
56	    """Each sentence in which the document says where it comes from, with its offset."""
57	    out = []
58	    for m in _SENTENCE.finditer(text):
59	        sentence = m.group(0)
60	        if not _ORIGIN.search(sentence):
61	            continue
62	        lead = len(sentence) - len(sentence.lstrip())
63	        quote = sentence.strip()
64	        out.append(OriginStatement(material_id, quote, m.start() + lead, identifiers_in(quote)))
65	    return tuple(out)
66	
67	
68	def _carries(text: str, identifier: str, skip: Iterable[OriginStatement]) -> bool:
69	    """True when the identifier occurs in the text outside the document's own origin sentences."""
70	    pattern = re.compile(r"(?<![\w-])" + re.escape(identifier) + r"(?![\w-])", re.IGNORECASE)
71	    spans = [(s.start_offset, s.start_offset + len(s.quote)) for s in skip]
72	    return any(not any(a <= m.start() < b for a, b in spans) for m in pattern.finditer(text))
73	
74	
75	def resolve_origins(texts: Mapping[str, str]) -> OriginMap:
76	    """Match each origin identifier to the one other document that carries it."""
77	    statements = {mid: origin_statements(mid, text) for mid, text in texts.items()}
78	    origins: dict[str, str] = {}
79	    unresolved, ambiguous, unnamed = [], [], []
80	    for mid, own in statements.items():
81	        for statement in own:
82	            if not statement.identifiers:
83	                unnamed.append(statement)
84	            for identifier in statement.identifiers:
85	                candidates = tuple(sorted(other for other, text in texts.items()
86	                                          if other != mid and _carries(text, identifier, statements[other])))
87	                if not candidates:
88	                    unresolved.append((mid, identifier))
89	                elif len(candidates) > 1:
90	                    ambiguous.append((mid, identifier, candidates))
91	                elif mid not in origins:
92	                    origins[mid] = candidates[0]
93	                elif origins[mid] != candidates[0]:
94	                    ambiguous.append((mid, identifier, tuple(sorted({origins[mid], candidates[0]}))))
95	    return OriginMap(origins, tuple(s for own in statements.values() for s in own),
96	                     tuple(unresolved), tuple(ambiguous), tuple(unnamed))

100	    text = material.extraction.text if material.extraction is not None else ""
101	    return text or material.content.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

108	    return resolve_origins({m.material_id: material_text(m) for m in materials

(Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)
